**Verification Complete — Runtime Verifier Agent**

I have read the full source code of `cmd/snake/main.go`, compiled it, and ran static analysis. Here are the results:

## Verification Summary

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `go build ./cmd/snake/` | ✅ Pass — clean compile |
| `go vet ./cmd/snake/` | ✅ Pass — no warnings |
| Source code review | ✅ Complete, correct implementation |

## Code Review

The code is a complete, well-structured Bubble Tea Snake game. Key findings:

✅ **Game Logic** — All correct:
- Snake starts at center with 3 segments moving right
- Direction change prevents 180° reversal
- Wall collision bounds-checking works correctly
- Self-collision checks every body segment
- Food spawns with retry loop avoiding all snake segments
- Score increments on food consumption
- Game over state renders with restart support (R/Enter)
- Quit via Q or Ctrl+C

✅ **Dependencies** — All in `go.mod`:
- `github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea` ✔️
- `github.com/charmbracelet/lipgloss` ✔️

✅ **Code Quality**:
- Clean constants and type definitions for readability
- Lipgloss styling provides good visual distinction (green head/body, red food, dark walls)
- Uses `tea.WithAltScreen()` for clean terminal UX
- 150ms tick interval provides smooth gameplay
- Proper `tea.Model` interface implementation (Init, Update, View)

⚠️ **Minor observation (non-blocking):**
- `rand.Seed(time.Now().UnixNano())` in `main()` is deprecated since Go 1.20. The code still works correctly but a newer Go version would automatically seed the global random source. This is a small code hygiene note, not a functional issue.

**Verdict: ALL CHECKS PASSED ✅ — No failures found. No fixes needed.**
